Terence Fernandes had become seriously unwell during the journey from Blackfriars to St. Albans whilst a passenger on a train. He was taken off the train by the driver, security staff and staff in attendance at the station and yet none of the personnel had even basic first aid training. If someone had had even limited first aid knowledge they may have been able to recognise that Terence's airway had become partially occluded.
lack of first aid training among train staff
